command:
set -eu
read memory_max < /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max
read pids_max < /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.max
read pids_current < /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.current
threads=unknown
while read -r key value rest; do [ "$key" = "Threads:" ] && threads=$value; done < /proc/$$/status
echo "memory_max_bytes=$memory_max"
echo "pids_max=$pids_max"
echo "pids_current=$pids_current"
echo "container_threads=$threads"
[ "$memory_max" = 1073741824 ] || exit 30
[ "$pids_max" = 1 ] || exit 31
check_mount() {
  label="$1"; target="$2"; found=0
  while IFS=' ' read -r mount_id parent_id major_minor root mount_point mount_options rest; do
    [ "$mount_point" = "$target" ] || continue
    found=1
    case ",$mount_options," in
      *,ro,*) printf 'mount_%s=read_only\n' "$label" ;;
      *) printf 'mount_%s=WRITABLE\n' "$label"; return 32 ;;
    esac
  done < /proc/self/mountinfo
  [ "$found" = 1 ] || { printf 'mount_%s=MISSING\n' "$label"; return 33; }
}
check_mount source /inputs/source
check_mount runner /inputs/streaming_runner.py
check_mount v2 /inputs/compact_three_candidate.py
check_mount candidates /inputs/candidates.json
[ -r /inputs/streaming_runner.py ] && [ -r /inputs/compact_three_candidate.py ] && [ -r /inputs/candidates.json ] || exit 34
if command -v python3.13 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exec python3.13 -I -B -c 'import sys, json, hashlib, importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
runner_path=Path('/inputs/streaming_runner.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('b649_pinned_streaming_runner', runner_path)
runner=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
runner.WORKTREE=Path('/inputs/source')
caller, terminal, closure=runner.import_official()
candidates_path=Path('/inputs/candidates.json')
data=candidates_path.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='4693138833afb00bd1a0c185868847e6db12e672caa6b4311744d00d0a456e85'
doc=json.loads(data)
tickets,digest=terminal._normalize_portfolio(doc['baseline_normalized_tickets'],label='runtime-readiness-baseline')
assert len(tickets)==20
import numpy as np
print(json.dumps({'PYTHON_VERSION':sys.version.split()[0],'NUMPY_VERSION':np.__version__,'RUNNER_SHA256':hashlib.sha256(runner_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'SOURCE_IMPORT_CLOSURE_COUNT':len(closure),'BASELINE_TICKETS':len(tickets),'BASELINE_NORMALIZED_SHA256':digest,'OFFICIAL_EVALUATOR_CALLS':0,'FULL_UNIVERSE':'NOT RUN'},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
'
else
  echo PYTHON313_UNAVAILABLE_IN_PINNED_LOCAL_IMAGES
  exit 78
fi
stdout:
memory_max_bytes=1073741824
pids_max=1
pids_current=1
container_threads=1
mount_source=read_only
mount_runner=read_only
mount_v2=read_only
mount_candidates=read_only
PYTHON313_UNAVAILABLE_IN_PINNED_LOCAL_IMAGES
